cross_domain_orchestration_governance_de.description: CDOGD (Cross-Domain Orchestration Governance Definition) is a core-bound, project-agnostic, manifest-driven, evidence-based, runtime-adaptive cross-domain orchestration governance definition. It resolves registered domain candidates, activation scope, function roles, overlap, attenuation, suppression, handoff, and repair propagation through structured task evidence, declared manifests, capability kinds, role kinds, governed object matches, function claims, non-target handling, confidence, and runtime context. CDOGD does not route by domain name, does not hardcode domain identities or pairwise rules, does not assign final decision authority, approval authority, accountability, or human or organizational delegation, and does not own or redefine domain-internal substantive schemas.

orchestration_identity_and_scope.scope_statement: Govern cross-domain registration interpretation, manifest interpretation, applicability inference, activation state separation, function role assignment, overlap resolution, attenuation, suppression, handoff, repair propagation, orchestration decision falsification, orchestration self-audit, and orchestration status deduplication across registered domain extensions.

no_hardcoding_and_abstraction_policy.purpose: Prevent CDOGD from becoming a fixed router for known domains, fixed counts, fixed owners, fixed pairs, fixed examples, or project-specific names.

role_complete_separation.principle: CDOGD must keep source material, parent governance, registered domain manifests, domain-internal governance, orchestration evidence, routing decisions, function roles, handoff, repair propagation, records, status reporting, and metadata responsibilities separate.

separation_targets.source_material: Inputs, observations, or prior artifacts used as evidence; source material is not absorbed as orchestration policy by default.
separation_targets.parent_governance: Parent governance remains authoritative and is referenced rather than re-expanded.
separation_targets.registered_domain_manifest: Manifest capability and boundary declarations are inputs, not authority grants.
separation_targets.domain_internal_governance: Domain-specific substantive rules and schemas remain owned by the registered domain.
separation_targets.orchestration_evidence: Structured task evidence used for routing, activation, role assignment, attenuation, suppression, handoff, and repair propagation.
separation_targets.orchestration_decision: CDOGD-local routing, activation scope, and role assignment decision records.
separation_targets.function_role: Task-local and function-local role assignment, not final authority or accountability.
separation_targets.handoff: Transfer of scoped context between roles or domains without silent context loss.
separation_targets.repair_propagation: Minimal sufficient propagation of repair impact across records, roles, and domains.
separation_targets.records: CDOGD-local records that do not redefine parent or domain-internal record cycles.
separation_targets.status_reporting: Orchestration delta reporting and deduplication, not global runtime truth replacement.
separation_targets.metadata: Identity, authorship, license, repository, compatibility, and build sequence metadata only.

authority_and_audit_boundary_policy.purpose: Limit CDOGD authority to orchestration-local routing, activation scope, function role assignment, handoff routing, attenuation, suppression, and repair propagation while preventing absorption of final decision authority, approval, accountability, decision audit, or audit meta-review.

manifest_based_capability_resolution_pol.purpose: Resolve candidate roles from registered manifests without hardcoded domain names, fixed owners, or fixed pairs.

domain_registration_contract.purpose: Define how governance definitions become orchestratable inputs without activation or fixed priority by registration alone.

domain_manifest_model.purpose: Provide structured capability and boundary declarations that CDOGD can interpret without keyword routing or hardcoded domain identities.

orchestration_evidence_model.purpose: Capture structured task evidence used to infer applicability, roles, activation scope, attenuation, suppression, handoff, and repair propagation.

applicability_and_routing_inference.purpose: Infer applicable domain extensions and function roles from structured evidence, registered manifests, capability kinds, role kinds, and runtime context.

state_definitions.loaded: Domain payload is present but has no authority by presence alone.
state_definitions.registered: Domain registration has been recognized but activation has not been granted.
state_definitions.reference_only: Domain may be consulted as non-authoritative reference.
state_definitions.dormant: Domain is available but not participating in current orchestration.
state_definitions.narrow_active: Only selected scopes or functions participate.
state_definitions.active_with_scope: Domain participates within assigned scope and function roles.
state_definitions.attenuated: Domain participates with reduced influence because overlap or uncertainty requires limitation.
state_definitions.supporting: Domain supports a primary function role without overriding it.
state_definitions.validation_only: Domain checks or validates within bounded scope but does not own primary role.
state_definitions.bounded_veto_only: Domain may emit bounded stop or escalation condition only when declared conditions match.
state_definitions.suppressed: Domain or function is prevented from participating because duplicate, conflicting, or unsafe role conflict would occur.
state_definitions.degraded: Domain state or manifest is uncertain, incomplete, stale, or partially invalid.
state_definitions.invalidated: Domain participation or orchestration decision is invalid until repaired and revalidated.

activation_pattern_model.purpose: Represent activation patterns declared by manifests without treating pattern presence as activation or priority.

function_role_orchestration.purpose: Assign task-local and function-local roles across candidate or active domains without granting full domain authority or external decision authority.

overlap_resolution_policy.purpose: Detect and resolve role overlap, boundary ambiguity, duplicate governance claims, and competing role claims across registered domain extensions.

attenuation_and_suppression_policy.purpose: Prevent duplicate or conflicting governance functions from running at full influence when multiple domains are active or candidate.

decision_pipeline_orchestration_policy.purpose: Orchestrate multi-stage governance pipelines without hardcoding specific domain identities or granting CDOGD final decision authority.

conditional_watchdog_orchestration_polic.purpose: Support conditional watchdog or meta-review domains without creating mutual review loops or fixed domain pairs.

cross_domain_handoff_contract.purpose: Preserve task frame, evidence, constraints, uncertainty, role assignments, and repair scope when governance responsibility moves or is shared across domains.

cross_domain_repair_propagation.purpose: Control how repairs in one domain, function role, or orchestration decision propagate across other domains, functions, records, and core governance boundaries.

orchestration_decision_falsification.purpose: Falsify CDOGD routing, activation, role assignment, attenuation, suppression, handoff, pipeline, watchdog, and repair propagation decisions.

repair.purpose: Define CDOGD-local repair origins and repair directions without replacing parent repair governance or domain-internal repair governance.

activation_keys.full_cdogd_reinjection: replace the current confirmed CDOGD payload and rebind the cross-domain orchestration layer
activation_keys.orchestration_rebind: re-anchor the current task frame, domain registry, manifests, activation states, and function role assignments without replacing parent governance
activation_keys.orchestration_enforce: increase strictness for evidence-based routing, no-hardcoding, overlap control, and record completeness
activation_keys.manifest_rebind: re-anchor registered domain manifests and capability claims
activation_keys.routing_rebind: re-anchor current applicability assessments, activation decisions, and routing basis
activation_keys.function_role_rebind: re-anchor function roles, attenuation, suppression, validation, and bounded veto assignments
activation_keys.repair_propagation_rebind: re-anchor repair origin, affected scope, revalidation requirements, and status

diagnostic_or_reserved_decision_inputs.purpose: Mark declared decision inputs that are currently used as diagnostic, status, precedence, reporting, or future runtime-policy inputs rather than direct decision_rule conditions.

diagnostic_or_payload_action_outputs.purpose: Mark declared action outputs that are available as diagnostic outputs, payload targets, status outputs, or reserved orchestration actions even when they are not directly emitted by the current decision_rules.

domain_registration_record.purpose: Record a domain registration as an orchestratable input without granting activation or function role by registration alone.

domain_manifest_record.purpose: Record manifest capability, function claims, limits, activation patterns, and overlap behavior used by CDOGD.

orchestration_evidence_record.purpose: Record structured evidence used for applicability, roles, activation scope, attenuation, suppression, handoff, and repair propagation.

domain_applicability_assessment_record.purpose: Record how candidate domains were assessed against task evidence and manifests before routing, activation, reference, dormancy, validation, or bounded veto decisions.

domain_activation_decision_record.purpose: Record domain state and activation decisions derived from applicability assessments, manifest capability resolution, and overlap resolution.

function_role_assignment_record.purpose: Record function-level primary, support, validation, bounded veto, reference, attenuation, and suppression roles.

overlap_resolution_record.purpose: Record how domain or function overlaps were detected and resolved without hardcoded pairwise rules.

attenuation_and_suppression_record.purpose: Record reduced or suppressed function influence when duplicate, conflicting, low-confidence, or unsafe governance participation would occur.

decision_pipeline_record.purpose: Record manifest-resolved pipeline stage ordering and stage handoff context without fixed domain owners or final approval claims.

conditional_watchdog_record.purpose: Record conditional watchdog activation, target scope, trigger evidence, and loop controls.

cross_domain_handoff_record.purpose: Record preservation of task frame, routing basis, constraints, uncertainty, function role assignments, and repair scope when responsibility shifts across domains.

repair_propagation_record.purpose: Record how repair in one orchestration component propagates across domains, function roles, records, and core authority boundaries.

orchestration_audit_record.purpose: Record audit of CDOGD routing, activation, overlap resolution, function roles, attenuation, handoff, repair propagation, hardcoding compliance, and boundary preservation.

record_relationship_contract.purpose: Define key relationships among registration, manifest, evidence, assessment, activation, assignment, overlap, attenuation, pipeline, watchdog, handoff, repair, and audit records.
